## Summary

Describe the problem, the bounded change, and any deliberately unsupported behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Original/source behavior is identified where applicable.
- [ ] Focused tests were added or updated where applicable.
- [ ] Unity compilation and directly affected tests were run, or the reason they were unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] Substantial changes passed the complete EditMode suite and proportional physical validation.
- [ ] No original Arcanum retail assets or generated retail-data caches are included.
- [ ] No unrelated gameplay-authority or presentation ownership changes are included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior or boundaries changed.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
